name: How do I choose a pool removal contractor in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What qualifications matter most when hiring a company for pool demolition and backfill?
mainEntity.text: What qualifications matter most when hiring a company for pool demolition and backfill?

acceptedAnswer.text: A good pool removal contractor should be able to explain the demolition method, permit process, hauling plan, backfill material, compaction steps, and final grading in plain language. Local experience matters because Los Angeles-area cities can differ in permitting, inspections, and site conditions. Ask to see recent pool-removal projects with similar access and pool type. You should also confirm whether the contractor handles permit coordination, utility locating, and disposal. The best companies give a written scope that separates demolition from optional landscaping or hardscape work so there are no surprises. If the bid is unusually low, make sure it is not missing hauling, compaction, or cleanup. A reliable contractor will be specific about what is included and what the site will look like when the job is complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a contractor with local permit experience, excavation equipment, compaction knowledge, and clear restoration scope. The best bids explain access, hauling, backfill, drainage, and finish grading in writing, rather than giving a vague flat price.
